dispatches.feedback_brief:
Two edits:

1. COVERAGE MATRIX PREAMBLE (I-CA-001, must-do): add a one-line preamble at the top of the Coverage Matrix (currently lines 51-128). Recommended wording: 'AC ID conventions. PRD-original AC-FR-N-x IDs are treated as aliases for their Blueprint-expanded forms (AC-CC-N-x for Claude-Code-layer FRs, AC-CS-Nx-y for Codespaces FRs, AC-CICD-N-x for CI/CD FRs). The matrix below indexes by the Blueprint-expanded form only; for reverse lookups from a PRD-original ID, consult plan-v1.md Acceptance Test Cross-Reference.' Alternatively a small alias table mapping each PRD-original family to its Blueprint-expanded counterpart. No test re-authoring; no Coverage Matrix row changes.

2. SHA-EQUALITY GAP (I-CA-007, your call between two paths):

   Path (a) - author AT-080. A small static-inspection test asserting that the 'uses:' SHA values in the FR-5 CI workflow and the FR-4c CI workflow are byte-identical for actions/checkout and for devcontainers/ci. Mirror the shape of AT-052 and AT-062 (which inspect each workflow's permissions/credentials separately). Map AT-080 to AC-CICD-4c-x and AC-CICD-5-x in the Coverage Matrix (or to AC-X-1 if the cross-mechanism framing fits better).

   Path (b) - update Open Coverage Gaps item 7 (currently line 1381) to: 'Resolved by Phase Validator PV-3 Operational checks line 394, which asserts that FR-5 and FR-4c cite the SAME resolved SHA for actions/checkout and devcontainers/ci via SHA string-comparison across both files. No discrete AT-NNN is required; the cross-workflow SHA-equality check lives in the validator surface.'

   Auditor's recommendation: path (b) is cheaper and PV-3 already covers it; the gap is documentary, not substantive. Choose path (b) unless you judge that the check should live in the test surface (e.g., to run on every change rather than only at phase-validator boundaries), in which case author AT-080.

Add a v1.0.1 entry to revision_history citing reconciliation-log-r3.md as the source and listing both edits (which path you chose for I-CA-007). No other changes - the matrix is exhaustive in both directions, all 79 ATs have AC coverage, and the rest of the document is sound.

dispatches.feedback_brief:
One edit, purely additive:

Add a one-paragraph inheritance-convention note at the head of Acceptance Criteria (immediately after the section heading, before the AC enumeration begins). Recommended wording:

  AC inheritance convention. This Blueprint enumerates inline only those Acceptance Criteria that arose from per-layer Design integration (the AC-CC-*, AC-CS-*, AC-CICD-* families) and the two cross-cutting NFR ACs added in v2.2 (AC-NFR-14, AC-NFR-15). AC-NFR-1-a through AC-NFR-13-b inherit verbatim from prd-v1.md Non-Functional Requirements (lines 340-407) and are not re-stated here. The inheritance mirrors the Functional Requirements convention ('see PRD FR-N') and is intentional: the v2.2 lift cycle scoped only to ACs that the Plan and Tests cited but Blueprint v2.1 did not define; AC-NFR-1-a..AC-NFR-13-b were already cited by ID and defined in the PRD canon, so the inheritance has always resolved cleanly.
